productConcept.name: Plinth Press
productConcept.description: Small-edition letterpress and fine printing studio in Edinburgh, founded 2009. Handset metal type, dampened cotton paper, one sheet at a time.
productConcept.rationale: The weld-ivory design system pairs Apple-derived structural precision (achromatic palette, tight grid) with EB Garamond's warm editorial serif and Manrope's geometric sans-serif — a combination that signals deliberate, material production rather than digital-first commerce. Plinth Press avoids all forbidden concepts and the gravitational pull toward fashion/beauty brands; instead it grounds the same aesthetic in the physical craft of letterpress printing, where the design system's 'pressed paper' and 'weight of impression' metaphors become literal.
